In detail

This barri saw a genuine and recent cluster of gun violence: a fatal shooting on Carrer de la Mineria on 8 June 2026 was the second lethal shooting on the same street within a month and the third violent incident recently. Officials attribute it to 'ajustes de cuentas' between organized-crime/drug-trafficking groups rather than danger to residents or tourists generally, but multiple fatal public shootings within weeks warrant a cautious rating for both day and especially night. Sources checked: Metrópoli Abierta, 8 June 2026; Telecinco; Infobae; laciutat.cat.

This rating comes from a structured local-source assessment. This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Barcelona publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is la Marina de Port safe?

Wandroz currently rates la Marina de Port in Barcelona as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Barcelona during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Barcelona at night.
